title: Secondary type
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose a face for sustained reading and everyday digital work. Showing the same line as the primary-type page helps a reader hear the change in emphasis.
strategic_value: Bolt can use Inter for body copy and choose available Google-tool substitutes while keeping a distinction between headlines and explanatory text.
demonstration: The text assigns Inter to body and digital use and specifies Google-tool substitutions. The specimen identifies Inter Tight by Rasmus Andersson, repeats the checkout line and compares Medium with Semi Bold.
practical_value: Use Inter where body copy and digital labels need clarity. For a Google document or slide, consult the separate instructions for headline and body weights.
